name: 叮咚买菜
description: 分组 partD · 上游 fmz200/wool_scripts
text:
#!name=叮咚买菜
#!desc=某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思
#!homepage=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts
#!icon=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/icons/gif/naisi-01.gif
#!raw-url=https://github.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/raw/main/Loon/plugin/split/partD/DingDongMaiCai.lpx
#!tg-channel=https://t.me/inaisi
#!date=2026-11-11 21:17:23
#############################################


[Argument]
ddmc_enable = switch,true,false,tag=叮咚买菜-脚本开关

[Rule]
DOMAIN, trackercollect.ddxq.mobi, REJECT
DOMAIN, ddfs-public.ddimg.mobi, REJECT
DOMAIN, rttrack.ddxq.mobi, REJECT


[Rewrite]
# 开屏广告
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/advert\//i then reject(404)
# 首页弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/getHomeAdPop/i then reject(404)
# VIP开通弹窗
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/vip\/getVipAd/i then reject_dict(200)
# 首页悬浮窗
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/newDetails/i then response.body.replace(/suspension/, "fmz200")
# 我的页VIP栏净化
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/gw\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/vip-app-service\/vip\/my\/page\/advertising/i then reject(404)
# 我的页弹窗(暂未启用)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/queryMyPagePopup/i then reject_dict(200)
# 我的页-猜你喜欢
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/userLike/i then reject_dict(200)
# 购物车顶部VIP横条
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/cart\/vipGuide/i then reject_dict(200)
# 购物车-猜你喜欢
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/order\/getRecommend/i then reject_dict(200)


[Script]
# 开屏广告及首页推荐流及底部状态栏优化
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/(?>bottomNavi|homeFlowDetail)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/ddxq.js") with enable=${ddmc_enable}, tag="叮咚买菜", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 右下角AI
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/tool\/getConfig/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/ddxq.js") with enable=${ddmc_enable}, tag="叮咚买菜", timeout=60, requires_body=true
# 我的页净化
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/user\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/userportal-service\/api\/v\d\/user\/queryMyPage/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zirawell/R-Store/main/Res/Scripts/AntiAd/ddxq.js") with enable=${ddmc_enable}, tag="叮咚买菜", timeout=60, requires_body=true




[MITM]
hostname = maicai.api.ddxq.mobi, gw.api.ddxq.mobi, user.api.ddxq.mobi
